title: BEST Events
description: Schema for domain events published by BEST-compliant services (io.best.agents.events).

event.description: An immutable domain event published by a BEST-compliant service as the result of processing a command. CloudEvent 1.0 envelope — the type field identifies the domain fact (e.g. CounterProposed, OrderSubmitted), and source identifies the service that published it.

eventList.description: Response body for GET /events. Lists domain events published by this service, with optional cursor for pagination.

nextCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Present when more results exist beyond the current page. Pass as ?after= in the next request. Absent when this is the last page.
